base_description: [Fix] Fix extra uninstall of cutlass packages (#25756)
python_tree_id_meaning: git rev-parse cd012ad:python, i.e. the tree of the python/ directory of the commit the 28-patch series was made against. The unmodified upstream baseline is exactly this tree.
extraction: git -C <patched checkout> archive cd012ad python | tar -x -C <upstream dir>  (scripts/upstream_runtime.py prepare does this and refuses unless the extracted tree hashes to python_tree_id)
isolation: the upstream server runs from its own directory put first on PYTHONPATH, with the patched checkout untouched; scripts/upstream_runtime.py check-import proves which sglang a launch environment imports
note: This file is the pinned identity of the independent upstream baseline. It is not a Qualification Record and qualifies nothing.
